title: Mike Patrick, and the kids in training
description: Group photograph among rocks, high above a hazy plain: about a dozen young soldiers, many in spotted camouflage — kids in training, his son relayed — pose with Mike Patrick, the tall man at center with his arm around one of them. Larry thinks, his son relayed, that Patrick was a ranger with a special operations group for MACV, what you would call a ghost or a spook. The kid in the bottom right, his son relayed, held an M1. Another man sits on the rocks at the far right edge.
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0010-c18035161.json). Answers the survey's open question — the tall central man is Mike Patrick, not Sgt. Lowry. NO PLACE IS SET (2026-09-14): the record had carried location nui-ba-den, 'mountaintop' and 'the Tây Ninh plain', and all three came only from the 2026-08-09 vision survey's setting hypothesis; neither comment on this frame names a place, so they were removed under rule 4, with the nui-ba-den timeline link. The related-photo links to VN-0006 and VN-0009 are kept as comparisons, not as a placement. 'Special operations group for MACV' maps naturally onto MACV-SOG (activated January 1964), which would fit the 'ghost'/'spook' reputation; treat as a lead for rosters, not a settled unit assignment. The seated American at the right edge is unidentified — interview goal.
